profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Engineer with 10 years of experience in designing and implementing scalable software solutions, specializing in data virtualization and cloud technologies. Proven leader in driving product development and enhancing team collaboration to optimize performance and user experience.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Originally a member of the Virtualization SDK team, then switched over to the brand new Compliance Services (DCS) SaaS team.
• Designed and led the Plugin Runtime project to stop running virtualization plugin code inside our own JVM and instead run it in a separate Docker container
• Tech lead to the DCS for Salesforce product building the full product and framework from the ground up to mask data on Salesforce on the cloud
• Led the new DCS for Azure team that built and supported our product that supports compliance on Azure Data factory and Azure Synapse Analytics

positions.title: Senior Member Of Technical Staff 2
positions.description:
• Member of the Virtualization team responsible for integrating with MSSQL, Sybase ASE, and the Virtualization SDK to support sources that aren't natively supported
• Member of the Toasty Sharks, Delphix's Toastmasters Club to work on public speaking
• Implemented data ingestion from NetBackup to integrate with customers’ existing workflows
• Developed the data virtualization platform in Java & SDK in Python to integrate with data sources that weren't natively supported

positions.title: Senior Member Of Technical Staff 1
positions.description:
• Member of the Sybase virtualization team responsible for integrating with Sybase ASE
• Added features to be able to ingest Sybase databases and virtualize them down to a specific time (Log sync)
• Worked with the DevOps team to build a new framework of building golden images across different platforms  
• Interviewed new candidates for both interns and new hires
• Participated in the Intern project by mentoring someone for 12 weeks while they finished a small project
